points.citation: Sales last year were up 20%.
We saw demand for Germany heat pumps on the sales side up about 20% in Germany.
In Q4, our resi sales were down about 40%, and we expect resi sales in Q1 in the Americas to be down about 20%-25%.
With respect to Q4, we expect CSA resi sales down approximately 30% and volumes down about 40% and continued significant headwinds from underabsorption as the channel continues to destock.
If you think about the second half of this year, Jeff, we'll see sales up about 20% in the back half, of course, off of some relatively easy compares.
That is the unit volume from distributors to dealers, which was down 8% in the quarter, and lower field inventories, which were down about 35% year-over-year.
In terms of your question on movement, movement was down about 30%, it looks like in October, and we expect movement to be down in the mid-20% for November and December.
And as you'll see in our outlook, the cost actions that we execute into 2025 will deliver over $100 million of savings in 2026.
We're adding to the cost reduction actions we initiated earlier this year to right-size the business and now expect carryover savings in 2026 to amount to over $100 million.
